predicate BitsEqualExcept(bits1: list[bool], bits2: list[bool], idx: int) {
    ((len(bits1) == len(bits2)) ∧
        (∀(i: int) ::
            (((0 <= i < len(bits1)) ∧
                (i != idx)) ==>
                (bits1[i] == bits2[i]))))
}
